mapper.select: WITH p AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography AS g ) SELECT w.facility_type AS type, w.weight, w.full_dist_m, w.zero_dist_m, n.id AS facility_id, n.name, n.lat, n.lng, ROUND(n.dist::numeric) AS dist_m, ROUND(( w.weight * GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, (w.zero_dist_m - COALESCE(n.dist, 1e12)) / (w.zero_dist_m - w.full_dist_m)::float8)) )::numeric, 1) AS point FROM campingsafe.score_weights w CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.id, f.name, f.lat, f.lng, ST_Distance(f.geom, p.g) AS dist FROM campingsafe.facilities f WHERE f.type = w.facility_type AND COALESCE(f.is_active, true) AND f.geom IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.geom <-> p.g LIMIT 1 ) n ON true ORDER BY w.weight DESC, w.facility_type

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.address, c.lat, c.lng, ROUND(SUM( w.weight * GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, (w.zero_dist_m - COALESCE(n.dist, 1e12)) / (w.zero_dist_m - w.full_dist_m)::float8)) )::numeric, 1) AS total_score FROM campingsafe.facilities c CROSS JOIN campingsafe.score_weights w LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ST_Distance(f.geom, c.geom) AS dist FROM campingsafe.facilities f WHERE f.type = w.facility_type AND COALESCE(f.is_active, true) AND f.geom IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.geom <-> c.geom LIMIT 1 ) n ON true WHERE c.type = 'camp' AND c.geom IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(c.is_active, true) GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.address, c.lat, c.lng ORDER BY total_score DESC, c.name
